messages.author: f4c2e63aec3c6db2
messages.subject: stackoverflow question monitoring?
parts:
There are questions tagged with "stan", "rstan", and "pystan" showing up
on Stackoverflow at a respectable rate. (I also notice that the pymc
devs are fielding a lot of questions on Stackoverflow.)

In the interest of getting these questions answered, it might be useful
to write a script to "forward" all questions tagged with "stan", "rstan"
or "pystan" into stan-users or (a new mailing list) stan-users-external.

Thanks,

Allen
